subject: Incorporating temporal replication into distance sampling analysis in unmarked

messages.author: fdaa54d30ab7b913
messages.subject: Incorporating temporal replication into distance sampling analysis in unmarked
parts:
Dear list members,

I am trying to run a distance sampling analysis in unmarked.

I have temporal replication for the transects (the transects where sampled during 5 consecutive days).  How can I incorporate this information into the analysis framework?

Thank you very much in advance.

Best,

Manuel
